# Which job offer actually pays more?

> Free job offer comparison calculator. Enter up to three offers with base, bonus, sign-on, equity and hours to see four-year average pay, true hourly rate, and the base salary you would need to counter with. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
